title: The naive framing: "Claude decides which companies to invest in"
text: You guess Claude decides which companies to invest in once it picks up deal sourcing. It doesn't. It just finds candidates. Let's see what's actually inside that file.

title: Sounds like investment judgment
text: Here Claude has a deal sourcing skill, and it sounds like Claude itself can judge which companies are worth investing in.

title: Broken, with a case — delete the folder, nothing is lost
text: But nothing in the model changes. Delete the skills folder and Claude doesn't lose any investment judgment. There was none to begin with. It just stops running that three-step checklist.

title: The anchor: one file — deal-sourcing's single SKILL.md, three steps
text: Here's what a skill actually is, one file. Deal sourcing, for instance, is a folder holding a single skill. MD three steps in order. Search a sector for target companies, check the CRM for existing relationships, draft a personalized outreach email to the founder.

title: Read it, then follow it in order: search, check CRM, draft email
text: Claude reads that file top to bottom and works through it step by step. Search the sector, check the CRM, draft the email, no branching unless the file itself says branch.

title: Spec, not judgment — the payoff and the limit
text: That makes a skill a specification, not new judgment. The payoff, the same three steps every sector every time. The limit, ranking those candidates by how good an investment they are, that's not on the page. So deal sourcing never gave Claude

title: The anchor returns — same file, every run
text: Judgment about which deals are good. It just guarantees that every time it runs, Claude reads that same file and works through the same three steps. That's the whole trick. Watching Claude surface 20 candidate companies proves the search step ran. It

title: Both directions — neither one is proof
text: Proves nothing about whether any of them are a good investment. And watching it draft a clean, personalized outreach email proves nothing about whether the founder ever replies. A skill named deal sourcing doesn't hand Claude investment

title: Carry-out
text: Judgment. It finds candidate companies and drafts the outreach. Whether any of it's a good deal is still on you. Your turn. Paste this into Claude. Pick one repeatable search and outreach

title: Your turn
text: Routine you run over and over sourcing candidates for anything, not just deals. Write me a skill MD for it, the steps in order plain language, then read it back to me and walk me through exactly what you'll do before you do it. Claude deal sourcing lay 'em in for bare.
